name: InlineEditGrid
tagline: The Inline Edit Grid shows a list of records - for example the lines of a purchase order - as a table you can edit directly, like a spreadsheet.
description: The Inline Edit Grid shows a list of records - for example the lines of a purchase order - as a table you can edit directly, like a spreadsheet. Instead of opening each record, changing one field and saving, you change the cells you need, see at a glance what you have changed, fix anything the grid flags, and save everything with one click.
features: Yes/No and Choice cells in place with inline validation, change highlighting
Totals and one-click Save (Dataverse) or a changes JSON output for canvas Patch
